calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, estimate rolling 60-session beta to the equal-weight benchmark return, calculate the 5-session return residual, and take its contrarian negative scaled by 20-session volatility. Every input is lagged one completed session before signal use.

validation.period: 2026-07-16 through 2029-11-28 (available observations; warmup calculations begin earlier)
validation.regime_notes: Online-period observations: 2026-07-16 to 2027-12-31 IC 0.044826, ICIR 0.156869 (367 dates); 2028-01-01 to 2029-11-28 IC 0.034501, ICIR 0.110140 (488 dates). Pre-online periods had no valid observations because the synthetic files begin later for this benchmark setup. Small cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
